_comment: Any Claude Code session opened in this repo - including a Remote Control
session being driven from claude.ai - gets the studio's job queue as tools,
so long renders are enqueued rather than run inside the session. That
matters because a Remote Control session ends after roughly ten minutes
offline, while a queued job does not.
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is set in the server's environment rather than Claude
Code's own, so a project-scoped entry must supply the :-. default.
The interpreter comes from install/wsl/bootstrap.sh; until that has run,
this server shows as failed in /mcp, which is the honest state.
